Team Lead Amsterdam UvA  Amsterdam Team Lead Based at the University of Amsterdam campus Roeterseiland. Starting end of December/ beginning of January . About Wakuli We are building the future of coffee. One that is seriously good for drinkers, farmers and the planet. How? By working directly with farmer groups around the world. We set up transparent, traceable export lines, freshly roast ourselves and serve the coffee straight to customers. These short supply chains make sure we can always pay farmers a good price, while also investing in fully regenerative coffee production. You'll find us in bars across the Netherlands, and online through our own platform. For customers, that means freshly roasted specialty coffee that's easy to get, and just seriously delicious. We are building the future of coffee with a team of like-minded people from all over the world. And we're looking for you. What You'll Do You as a Team Lead During your working days, you'll be behind the bar - welcoming guests, brewing coffee, sharing the Wakuli story, and ensuring the store is clean and filled with positive energy. In addition to your regular bar shifts, you will have some extra responsibilities. - Assign daily tasks and make sure they are completed. - Solve issues on the floor and escalate when needed. Scheduling - Build and maintain the weekly roster for your store. - Ensure proper shift coverage based on availability and store needs. Store hygiene & safety - Uphold hygiene and safety standards (HACCP). - Ensure a clean, safe and compliant store environment. What You Bring - At least 2 years of experience in retail or hospitality - Fluent in English and preferably Dutch - Strong knowledge of, or willingness to quickly learn about, specialty coffee - Excellent communication skills and emotional intelligence - Available for at least 16 hours per week (3 - 4 shifts)
